answer.reason: In Table 1 of the EIA Arkansas Electricity Profile 2024, the IPP & CHP (independent power producers and combined heat and power) net generation line is 7,156,529 megawatthours. The larger figure, 54,385,955 megawatthours, corresponds to Arkansas's total net generation across all producer types, not the IPP & CHP category alone — Arkansas's generation is dominated by investor-owned utilities (Entergy Arkansas, SWEPCO, OG&E) and cooperatives, with IPP/CHP facilities (e.g., Union Power Station, industrial CHP) contributing only a minority share of roughly 7 million MWh. The supplied draft answer A therefore reflects the total row rather than the IPP & CHP row.
